title: watchDeploymentActivities
responsibility: Polls host-wide deployment jobs, rejects stale replies and returns a cleanup function.

inputs.name: watchDeploymentActivities.workspace
inputs.description: The workspace state used to decide whether polling is allowed and whether a reply still belongs to the active bridge. Polling requires a local workspace with a deploymentActivities method, and a reply is accepted only while the workspace remains local and keeps the same bridge.

inputs.name: watchDeploymentActivities.events
inputs.description: Callbacks used to tag each poll with a numeric version and deliver its activities or report an unavailable-status message. A result or failure is delivered only while the same local workspace bridge that started the poll remains current.

outputs.name: watchDeploymentActivities
outputs.description: The cleanup callback deactivates this watcher and clears its 500 ms interval. It does not cancel an in-flight bridge request, but such a reply is ignored after cleanup.
